headline: Two cocktails hurled outside PM’s Office in Dhaka
summary: One cocktail exploded while the other was defused by the DMP bomb disposal unit after the incident occurred around 1:15 AM on Friday.
details: Two cocktails were thrown by unidentified assailants in front of the Prime Minister's Office in Tejgaon, Dhaka.
The incident took place around 1:15 AM on Friday. One of the cocktails exploded, while the other was safely defused by the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) bomb disposal unit.
According to DC Ibn Mizan of the DMP's Tejgaon division, two motorcycle riders arrived at the scene and stayed for two to three minutes to observe the surroundings before throwing the cocktails.
The suspects are believed to have fled toward the Kafrul road via Agargaon after the attack.
Police have deployed teams to the field and are currently collecting CCTV footage from the surrounding areas to identify and arrest the suspects.
caption:
Two cocktails were hurled at the Prime Minister's Office in Dhaka at midnight. One exploded, while the other was defused by police.

Two cocktails were thrown by unidentified assailants in front of the Prime Minister's Office in Tejgaon, Dhaka.

The incident took place around 1:15 AM on Friday. One of the cocktails exploded, while the other was safely defused by the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) bomb disposal unit.

According to DC Ibn Mizan of the DMP's Tejgaon division, two motorcycle riders arrived at the scene and stayed for two to three minutes to observe the surroundings before throwing the cocktails.

The suspects are believed to have fled toward the Kafrul road via Agargaon after the attack.

Police have deployed teams to the field and are currently collecting CCTV footage from the surrounding areas to identify and arrest the suspects.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #PMO #Security #BreakingNews

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV

headline: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee detained ahead of Delhi protest
summary: The popular influencer was taken into custody at his Gurugram residence to prevent him from joining a CJP-led demonstration against electoral roll irregularities.
details: Germany-based YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained at his home in Gurugram on Saturday morning. He had recently traveled to India to participate in a planned protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar.
caption:
Popular YouTuber Dhruv Rathee has been detained by police in Gurugram to stop him from reaching a major protest in Delhi.

Germany-based YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained at his home in Gurugram on Saturday morning. He had recently traveled to India to participate in a planned protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar.
